format: maintainer fact sheet; not an official HOL submission schema
name: MCPSense
description: MIT-licensed CLI for inspecting supported MCP configurations, advertised metadata, source and agent-skill files, with structured findings, coverage and metadata-reference comparisons.

npm.requires: Node.js 22+; no Go compiler or MCPSense native executable

importantScope: MCPSense is a scanner CLI, not a tool-serving MCP server.
An initial scan supplies review signals, not a declaration that a server is safe.
The optional required-reference workflow compares recognized metadata to an operator-reviewed reference; the reference is not a publisher signature.
Runtime tool responses, host authorization and execution containment need separate controls.
The four synthetic offline demo cases are selected regression evidence, not a field-accuracy benchmark.

lead.identityClaim: The participant says they work with HOL on an open-source MCP catalog; the specific repository and submission format have not yet been verified.
